text:
adesh: Heads up — PR #4521 updates authz + VPC peering logic for Private deployments. Needs sec review for secrets handling (vault -> KMS scoping). Planning to merge in the maintenance window on Thu if approvals come through. CI is failing e2e with `vault: unauthorized` so flagging that too. ping @leah and @tim for reviews.
sec-bot: Automated security scan: 2 findings: 1) hardcoded test key in tests, 2) KMS policy is too broad (wildcard resource). See scan report link: https://security/reports/4521 :warning:
leah: Thanks — I'll take a look today. Quick question: can we split the KMS scoping change out from the authz logic so we can review separately?
adesh: I tried that — I put the KMS policy change in a separate commit on branch `authz/kms-scope`, but the migration script touches both tables so we need both to land in the same window. I can keep them separated in PR history but they must merge together.
tim: From infra side: note that the VPC peering changes require route-table updates in staging and prod and a cross-account role change. If we merge before Thu 10:00 PT we can stage the rollout during the maintenance window; otherwise it'll slip to next week. Also we need an infra ack for DB egress rules.
maria: Pushed a fix for the secret-rotation job — CI was failing because the rotation worker tried to use a test token. Current failing log excerpt: ```vault: error=unauthorized, cause=token not allowed for path secret/data/redwood/private``` I updated the test fixture to use role-bound tokens.
leah: Ok I can review in ~2h. For KMS scoping I suggest policy like: `{"Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234-efgh"}` — can you paste the exact snippet you'll deploy?
adesh: Adding policy snippet here: ```hcl
# minimal KMS policy for decryption
resource "aws_kms_key" "private_ops" {
  policy = <<POL
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234-efgh"}]
}
POL
}
```
leah: :eyes: quick nits — remove the hardcoded test key from tests, add a short smoke test that runs against the rotated credentials with a small TTL. After CI is green I'll approve. Also add a comment in the policy about the key ARN rotation plan.
adresh: (typo) meant adesh: Got it — removed hardcoded key and added smoke test. I also added a migration step in the PR description. Plan: if sec approves by EOD Wed, I'll queue for Thu 10:00 PT maintenance window. If not, we'll hold. @tim can you confirm infra will schedule route updates during the window?
tim: Confirmed. I'll schedule route-table changes and the cross-account role adjustment on Thu 10:00 PT and update the runbook `private-peering`. Will also add a temporary Slack alert to #incidents to notify if rotation fails.
sec-bot: Security checklist status: all automated checks passed except the KMS scope informational note. Please add `security:approved` tag after manual review.
maria: Re-ran CI after the last push — e2e now passes, vault calls succeed with role tokens. Logs show rotation job completed: `rotation: success, rotated_keys=1` — pushing for merge.
adash: Thanks everyone. Summary: split commits kept, but will merge together in Thu 10:00 PT window. @leah will do manual review and approve once CI is green. @tim will handle network changes in the window and update runbook. I'll post a follow-up thread with the deploy playbook and link to the runbook before merging. :thumbsup: :shipit:
leah: LGTM pending green build. Will approve ASAP. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: maintenance window Thu 10:00 PT — channel #infra-maintenance will be notified 30 minutes prior.
sec-bot: Manual note: address the KMS scope comment in PR description and add reviewer `leah` as approver. Once updated, mark `security:needs-approval` -> `security:approved`.
adash: CI is green on latest push, migration smoke tests pass. Queueing for the window. I'll post the playbook link in 30m.
maria: Quick follow-up — after merge please ensure the rotation worker has `MAX_RETRIES=5` to avoid transient vault auth issues. I added that env var in the deploy config.
adash: Noted. merging in window and will update runbook afterward. Thanks all!
